title: Valor Craft
description: Valor Craft – immerse yourself in the dark Middle Ages, where every step could be your last. Build castles, forge legendary weapons, and battle bosses who leave you no room for error.
body:
Welcome to the modpack where the Middle Ages come to life! Forget about boring vanilla survival — here, every day is a trial. You will face dark dungeons crawling with dangerous mobs and harsh lands filled with ancient secrets.

What awaits you?

Brutal Combat: A new combat system (Better Combat) turns every fight into a dance of death. Parry blows, dodge, and master various weapon types to overcome your foes.

Character Progression: You won't just craft a diamond sword. You will grow as a warrior! A leveling system  allows you to unlock new abilities, become faster, stronger, and more resilient.

Dungeons & Bosses: Test your strength in massive, hand-crafted dungeons. At the end of the path, powerful bosses await. Each one has unique mechanics, and defeating them will require not only a sharp sword but also cunning.

Building & Immersion: Build a real medieval castle, fortress, or village. New decorative blocks will allow you to create incredibly detailed and atmospheric buildings.

Get your gear ready, brave warrior. Your legend begins now!
